roles.name: signin
roles._why: Pre-login surface, captured on purpose: the design has five auth frames (Sign In, Choose Portal, three Implementing Agency states) that the authenticated crawl can never reach. Its captures are exempt from the login-page gate for that reason and no other.

live._navMode_why: This build logs the session out on a HARD RELOAD of /dashboard and /city-profiling (the smile_admin_token cookie is dropped). The default goto-crawl visits the landing route first, so one bad route poisoned an entire 49-screen run with login pages. 'spa' clicks the sidebar anchor instead — the way a person navigates — and never reloads. The refresh-logout is itself an audit finding, not just a capture problem.
live._skipRoutes_why: /login is deliberately NOT skipped any more: the authenticated roles redirect away from it harmlessly, and the `signin` role needs it.

baseline._modes: tokens (strict, vs inputs/tokens.json) | derived (from Figma variables) | internal (no DS - flag outliers)

notes: Passwords live in secrets.json (gitignored, symlinked to the main worktree). Credentials sourced 2026-09-10 from the shared 'Portal access - DEV and UAT test Logins' sheet. Three further roles are listed there with EMPTY credentials and cannot be captured: State Nodal Officer, Nodal Officer, Implementing Agency. A prod host also exists (https://smilebeggary-admin.dosje.gov.in) with a Test Super Admin account; this audit deliberately targets DEV.
_allowSharedAnchors_why: S08 and G17 are both about the breadcrumb's first step on Consent Forms — one per-screen, one global — so they legitimately resolve to the same design box. Every other duplicate is a copy-paste and the gate should fail on it.
_claimGates_why: The claim gates are fatal for this project: it is the one whose findings were audited claim by claim, so it is the reference implementation. A project without resolved anchors still gets the design-read gate and the claim classification, just not fatally.
